summarize this vendor services agreement in a playful pirate voice but keep the legal meaning crisp and accurate. i want the key obligations crystal clear: payment terms, termination triggers, liability caps, ip ownership, and indemnities. keep it concise and structured so i can scan it fast.

Vendor Services Agreement (excerpt)
Parties: Seaglass Inc. ("Client") and Harbor Labs LLC ("Vendor").
Scope: Vendor provides backend maintenance and feature development as described in Statements of Work (each, an "SOW").
Fees & Payment: Client pays a fixed fee of $18,000 per month for baseline services. Out-of-scope work requires written approval and is billed at $150/hour. Vendor invoices monthly in arrears; payment due net 15 days from invoice date. Late amounts accrue interest at 1.5% per month or the maximum allowed by law, whichever is lower. Client is responsible for applicable sales/use taxes (excluding Vendor's income taxes).
Term & Termination: Initial term: 12 months from Effective Date, auto-renewing for successive 12-month periods unless either party gives 30 days' notice before renewal. Either party may terminate for material breach not cured within 15 days after written notice. Client may terminate for convenience on 30 days' written notice. Either party may terminate immediately upon the other party's insolvency or cessation of business.
Intellectual Property: Each party retains ownership of its pre-existing IP and tools. Upon full payment of all fees for a Deliverable, Client owns all right, title, and interest in the Deliverables (excluding Vendor Tools). Vendor Tools (including libraries, frameworks, and internal utilities) remain Vendor's property; Vendor grants Client a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free license to use Vendor Tools solely as embedded in the Deliverables. Vendor retains a non-exclusive right to list the engagement and non-confidential deliverables in its portfolio.
Confidentiality: Mutual confidentiality obligations survive 3 years after termination.
Indemnification: Vendor will defend and indemnify Client against third-party claims alleging that the Deliverables, as provided by Vendor, infringe any U.S. intellectual property right, provided Client promptly notifies Vendor, gives Vendor sole control of the defense/settlement, and cooperates. Vendor has no obligation for claims arising from (i) Client materials, (ii) combinations not provided by Vendor, or (iii) modifications not made by Vendor. Client will defend and indemnify Vendor against third-party claims arising from Client data or instructions provided for the Services under similar notice/control/coop terms.
Limitations of Liability: EXCEPT FOR (a) a party's indemnification obligations, (b) breaches of confidentiality, and (c) willful misconduct, EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED AN AMOUNT EQUAL TO SIX (6) MONTHS OF FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY CLIENT AT THE TIME THE CLAIM AROSE. NEITHER PARTY IS LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES.

It must accurately state payment timing and late fees, termination rights and cure periods, the 6‑month fee liability cap with stated carve-outs, exact IP ownership/licensing boundaries, and mutual indemnities with conditions—style must not obscure or alter obligations.
